minutes_text:
Inglewood, California
  November 14, 2019

  The Housing Authority of the City of Inglewood, California held a special meeting on
  Thursday, November 14, 2019, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.

  APPOINTMENT OF MAYOR PRO TEM. It was moved by Council Member
  Franklin, and seconded by Council Member Padilla that the City Council does hereby
  appoint Council Member Morales as Mayor Pro Tem. The motion was carried by the
  following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Padilla, Franklin, and Council Member Morales;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Mayor Butts and Council Member Dotson.
  Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Pro Tem/Housing
  Authority Chairman Pro Tem Morales called the City Council/Housing Authority into
  joint session at the hour of 9:16 a.m.
  The City Clerk/Housing Secretary announced the presence of a quorum as follows:
  Present:  Mayor Pro Tem/Housing Authority Chairman Pro Tem
  Morales, Council Members/Housing Authority Members
  Padilla, and Franklin; and
  Absent:  Mayor/Housing Authority Chairman Butts and
  Council Member/Housing Authority Member Dotson.
  City/Housing Authority officials and personnel present for closed session were as
  follows:

  Yvonne Horton  City Clerk/Secretary*
  Artie Fields  City Manager/Executive Director*
  Ken Campos  City Attorney/General Counsel*
  David Esparza  Asst. City Manager/CFO
  Aisha Thompson  Deputy City Clerk

  * Serves as indicated for the Housing Authority.

  PUBLIC COMMENTS – AGENDA ITEMS. Mayor Pro Tem/Housing Authority
  Chairman Pro Tem Morales inquired if there were any persons present who wished to
  address the City Council/Housing Authority on any item on the Agenda.

  There was no response.

131.8  ACQUISITION OF PROPERTY APPROVED -3500 WEST MANCHESTER
  BOULEVARD, #354.  Staff report dated November 14, 2019, was presented
  recommending approval of the acquisition of property located at 3500 West Manchester
  Boulevard, #354, Inglewood, California, 90305, by the Inglewood Housing Authority
  from seller Francis Toliver for approximately $579,000, and the resale of the property
  from the Inglewood Housing Authority to affordable income household buyer and
  Homebuyer Assistance Program lottery winner, Qiana Rendine, at an affordable price of
  $312,500.

  It was moved by Council Member Franklin, and seconded by Council Member Padilla
  that the City Council does hereby: 1) Approve the acquisition and the resale of the
  property; and 2) Authorize the use of General Funds to pay for the acquisition and resale
  costs associated thereto. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Padilla, Franklin, and Mayor Pro Tem Morales;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Council Member Dotson, and Mayor Butts.

  It was moved by Housing Authority Member Franklin, and seconded by Housing
  Authority Member Padilla that the Housing Authority does hereby: 1) Approve the
  foresaid acquisition and resale of the property; 2) Authorize the Chairman to sign and
  deliver all documents to acquire and resell the property; and
 November 14, 2019

  3) Reimburse the General Fund for any advances necessary to consummate the
  transactions. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Housing Authority Members Padilla, Franklin, and Housing Authority Pro Tem
  Chairman Morales;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Housing Authority Member Dotson, and Housing Authority Chairman Butts.

 131.8  ACQUISITION OF PROPERTY APPROVED - 3552 WEST 111TH STREET. Staff
  report dated November 14, 2019, was presented recommending approval of the
  acquisition of property located at 3552 West 111th Street, Inglewood, California, 90303,
  by the Inglewood Housing Authority from seller Magnum Property Investments, LLC for
  approximately $600,000, and the resale of the property from the Inglewood Housing
  Authority to affordable income household buyer and Homebuyer Assistance Program
  lottery winner, Jazmine Covington, at an affordable price of $312,500.

  It was moved by Council Member Franklin, and seconded by Council Member Padilla
  that the City Council does hereby: 1) Approve the acquisition and the resale of the
  property; and 2) Authorize the use of General Funds to pay for the acquisition and resale
  costs associated thereto. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Padilla, Franklin, and Mayor Pro Tem Morales;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Council Member Dotson, and Mayor Butts.

  It was moved by Housing Authority Member Franklin, and seconded by Housing
  Authority Member Padilla that the Housing Authority does hereby: 1) Approve the
  aforesaid acquisition and resale of the property; 2) Authorize the Chairman to sign and
  deliver all documents to acquire and resell the property; and 3) Reimburse the General
  Fund for any advances necessary to consummate the transactions. The motion was
  carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Housing Authority Members Padilla, Franklin, and Housing Authority Pro Tem
  Chairman Morales;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Housing Authority Member Dotson, and Housing Authority Chairman Butts.

  There being no further business to be presented, Housing Authority Chairman Pro Tem
  Morales declared the meeting adjourned in honor of Ricardo Torres at the hour of 9:21
  a.m.

  Approved this 26th day of November, 2019.

  _________________________
  Yvonne Horton, Secretary
  _______________________________
  Eloy Morales, Jr., Chairman Pro Tem
